# SandBase

> AI models, data APIs, sandboxes and agents behind one API key, pay as you go. 2,000+ capabilities (1,700+ data APIs, 400+ AI models), 100 free data-API calls a day, free sandboxes (E2B-compatible) and free Agents (OpenAI Agents API-compatible).

Base URL: https://api.sandbase.ai. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY`. Every non-LLM capability: `POST /v1/run` with `{"model": "<name>", ...fields}`; async runs return an id to poll with `GET /v1/run/{id}`. LLMs: OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/responses`, Anthropic `/v1/messages`.

## Catalog
- [catalog/index.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/catalog/index.json): every capability with type, modes, endpoint and price summary
- catalog/models/<name>.json (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/catalog/models/openai/gpt-image-2.5-flare.json): input JSON Schema, output, modes, pricing, examples
- [openapi/sandbase.openapi.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/openapi/sandbase.openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1
- [docs/platforms/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/docs/platforms/README.md): capabilities grouped by platform

## Clients
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/sdk/python/README.md), [TypeScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/sdk/typescript/README.md), [Go](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/sdk/go/README.md): `run()` waits for sync and async results; Agents helpers
- [Sandboxes with the E2B SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/examples/sandbox/python/hello_sandbox.py)
- [Agents with the OpenAI SDK](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sandbaseai/sandbase/main/examples/agents/python/openai_agents.py)
